findings.title: Add structured error codes to validate_prd_output.py
findings.description: The PRD validator (scripts/validate_prd_output.py) reports failures as plain text strings in the validation result JSON. Add structured error codes (e.g. VAL-001 through VAL-010 matching the 10 validation rules) so downstream stages can programmatically identify which specific checks failed without parsing human-readable messages. This improves retry orchestrator decision-making when stage 5 validation fails.
